derivation: Write 5000 samples at 500 Hz into capacity 100.
The allocated numerical storage is 2400 bytes.
After wrapping, retain 100 most recent samples.
Chronological snapshot runs from 9.800000 to 9.998000 s.
The retained diagnostic horizon is 0.198000 s.
notes: Memory accounting covers the array payload, not interpreter, transport or rendering overhead.
The example is single-threaded; concurrent producers/consumers require a reviewed synchronization or lock-free design.
